svg.title: Every issue is a shot: dribble the issue, shoot the pull request, swish the merge.
svg.desc: A looping night-court scene. A player dribbles a green GitHub issue ball while the shot clock runs down, launches a buzzer-beater that becomes a blue pull request mid-air as CI checks pass along the arc, and swishes it through the hoop where it explodes into a purple MERGED celebration. A new issue immediately falls from the sky.
